audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Renekton/Skill/Renekton/Renekton — the exact inverse of the page's own whys, which give Renekton levels 1-3 and Sett everything from 4 on.
audit.why: The packet chart is Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, then Sett for the remaining four rows, and the 51.12% win rate over 3382 games fits an early bully who falls off.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet chart as matched full+content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] was written about 'levels 5' and whys[5] about level 6 — both one row off their labels (Level 6 and First item).
audit.why: The row labels are fixed: whys[4] is Level 6 and whys[5] is First item. As written the page announced the R spike under the item row and nothing at all under level 6.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now covers the level-6 Show Stopper spike, whys[5] the first-item sustain swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The empowered Ruthless Predator shield-destroy was absent from the whole page.
audit.why: Above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator (W, 300 range, 16/14/12/10/8s) slashes three times, DESTROYS damage shields on the target and stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Haymaker's entire value is the Grit shield — cashing it into an empowered W deletes it. It is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[5].t, spikes[0] and phases[2].why now state it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Executioner's Calling buy was in the item block but nothing in the trade text explained the timing.
audit.why: Cull the Meek (Q, 325 range, 7s flat) heals off every target it hits and heals more above 50 Fury — Grievous Wounds timing is what decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] now ties the first-item swing to the anti-heal buy.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Renekton on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Reign of Anger feeds off his autos and an empowered Ruthless Predator stuns for 1.5s, so level 1 is his. Farm it out, bank the Grit he gives you, and take the lane back at 4.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Renekton burns Ruthless Predator (Stun).
edits.after: Facebreaker is online, but level 3 is his peak: above 50 Fury his W destroys your Haymaker shield outright. Trade only once that W is spent.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Renekton Ruthless Predator: Empowered strike; with Fury it stuns longer — his all-in lockdown. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (W, 300 range, 16s at rank 1): a 0.75s stun, or 1.5s above 50 Fury — and the empowered version DESTROYS your Haymaker shield. It also resets his auto-attack, so the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and eats your shield. Bait it first.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Empowered W destroys damage shields — cash Haymaker after it, never into it.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His empowered W erases the Haymaker shield you just spent your Grit on.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator: above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and destroys your shield. Bait it, then E-stun + W.

edits.before: Levels 5 your health and passive sustain out-grind his fury-gated healing in extended fights.
edits.after: At 6 The Show Stopper plus a max-grit Haymaker shield flip his Dominus all-in back on him.

edits.before: R The Show Stopper plus grit shields let you survive and flip his Dominus (R) all-in at 6.
edits.after: First item swings it: your sustain out-grinds his fury-gated Cull the Meek healing.

edits.before: Renekton's level 3 all-in with two Cull the Meek (Q) heals and a Ruthless Predator (W) stun is his peak; if he burns fury early, wait it out and punish once his W is down.
edits.after: Level 3 is his peak: two Cull the Meek heals plus an empowered Ruthless Predator that destroys your Haymaker shield. Wait the Fury out, then punish once his W is down.

edits.before: After first item Sett's W true damage and passive out-sustain Renekton's fury-gated healing, so extended trades stop favoring him.
edits.after: After first item your true damage out-lasts his fury-gated Cull the Meek healing — an early Executioner's is what makes that trade one-sided.

edits.before: He keeps the edge until you hit 4-5, where your E-W grit pattern and health let you eat his combo; the E slow plus W finally out-trade his fury-gated burst.
edits.after: He keeps the edge until 4-5, where Facebreaker — which stuns only with enemies on both sides of you — plus a banked Grit bar finally out-trade his fury-gated burst.

edits.before: Use Slice (E) dash to reset and cancel your combo
edits.after: Use Slice and Dice to reset spacing between trades

notes: Sett's R carries a 'grounding' flag that is not in Riot's description of The Show Stopper, so nothing here claims it blocks Slice and Dice (the mirror made the same call). Renekton's R range reads 20 in the kit — a self-cast artifact, not used. Whether Ruthless Predator's stun can be tenacity-reduced or cleansed is not in the kit text and is not asserted.
